name: compass
description: AI coordination assistant for complex medical cases

interface.longDescription: Open-source AI coordination assistant for families navigating complex medical cases. Tracks case knowledge, coordinates care teams, drafts emails, manages to-dos, runs deep research with regulatory awareness, and flags proactive considerations. Works on Claude Code and Codex. All case data stays on your machine.
defaultPrompt: @onboarding — start here to set up your case files
@update — daily catch-up: new files, emails, calendar, briefing
@research — deep research on any medical question
@todo — view and manage your care team to-do list
@email — draft a message to a doctor, family member, or consultant
@prep — prep file for an upcoming call or appointment
@contacts — view or update the care team directory
@briefing — configure or send the daily briefing email
